title: Riot or breach of peace.
bodyText: Any person subject to this chapter who causes or participates in any riot or breach of the peace shall be punished as directed by a court-martial.
bodyHtml: [§124B-182]  Riot or breach of peace.  Any person subject to this chapter who causes or participates in any riot or breach of the peace shall be punished as directed by a court-martial. [L 2022, c 286, pt of §2]
